name: RTI-150
summary: RTI(-4229)-150, ((−)-2β-Carbocyclobutoxy-3β-(4-methylphenyl)tropane) is a phenyltropane derivative which acts as a potent dopamine reuptake inhibitor and stimulant drug. It is around 5x more potent than cocaine, but is more selective for the dopamine transporter relative to the other monoamine transporters.

pharmacology.text: RTI(-4229)-150, ((−)-2β-Carbocyclobutoxy-3β-(4-methylphenyl)tropane) is a phenyltropane derivative which acts as a potent dopamine reuptake inhibitor and stimulant drug. It is around 5x more potent than cocaine, but is more selective for the dopamine transporter relative to the other monoamine transporters.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: The RTI compounds come from the Research Triangle Institute in North Carolina, where F. Ivy Carroll's team made hundreds of phenyltropanes to work out which part of cocaine's structure does what.
fact.zh: RTI 系列化合物來自北卡羅來納州的研究三角研究院，F. Ivy Carroll 的團隊在那裡合成了數百種苯基托烷，以釐清古柯鹼結構中各部分的作用。
fact.zhHans: RTI 系列化合物来自北卡罗来纳州的研究三角研究院，F. Ivy Carroll 的团队在那里合成了数百种苯基托烷，以厘清古柯碱结构中各部分的作用。
